label: PF Backlog 72
title: BUG: max_duration_per_stage compares TOTAL pipeline elapsed time and counts HIL wait time
body: Observed live: a run stopped with 'Stop conditions triggered: [max_duration_per_stage]' after the 57-question interactive discovery panel waited ~5.4h for answers. Root cause in core/pipeline_executor.py check_stop_conditions() (~line 1904): metrics['duration_seconds'] = (now - execution.started_at) i.e. TOTAL PIPELINE elapsed time, but it is checked against the PER-STAGE condition max_duration_per_stage (3600s, core/stop_conditions.py). So (a) any run over 1h total trips it, and (b) human-wait time (interactive prompts + approvals) is counted as work time. FIX: (1) measure the ACTUAL stage duration (per-stage start time), not total pipeline time; (2) EXCLUDE human-wait seconds (accumulate time spent in interactive.ask and approval wait loops and subtract); (3) keep a separate per-run total time budget if desired. Also ensure interactive/HIL waits do not count toward tokens/cost/retry stop metrics.
